name: mRNA-1647
sort_evidence: mRNA-1647 failed its congenital CMV Phase 3 and that programme was discontinued, but Moderna stated it continues the Phase 2 in haematopoietic cell transplant recipients (NCT05683457, active not recruiting) (https://www.modernatx.com/media-center/all-media/blogs/phase-3-cmv-vaccine-readout-reflections).

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Immunogenicity of mRNA-1647 Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Vaccine in Allogenic Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (HCT) Participants.
